concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports clearer pores and fewer clogged pores after regular use, with smoother texture overall.
concerns.redness: One reviewer who says most scrubs leave their skin red reports this one does not irritate and leaves the complexion clearer and more even.
concerns.aging: One reviewer describes a noticeable glow and less dull, tired-looking skin after a few uses.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with rough patches on the arms reports they smoothed out within a couple of weeks, leaving skin refreshed.

aspects.libelle: Skin feels soft and polished after use
No irritation even on reactive skin

extraits.texte: The combination of papaya, pineapple, and pomegranate makes this feel like a high-quality product. My skin looks brighter and feels much softer after each use.

extraits.titre: Finally an exfoliator that doesn't irritate
extraits.texte: Most scrubs leave my skin red, but this one is completely different. It feels gentle while still removing dead skin. My complexion looks clearer and more even after using it.

extraits.titre: Noticeable glow after just a few uses
extraits.texte: After using this scrub twice a week, I started seeing a real glow. My skin looks fresher and less tired, especially in areas that used to look dull.
: I had some rough areas on my arms and this scrub smoothed them out within a couple of weeks. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed and renewed.
I've noticed my pores looking less clogged since I started using this. My skin texture is smoother and makeup applies much better now.

extraits.titre: Great for maintaining even skin tone
extraits.texte: This scrub helped improve my uneven skin tone over time. It gently removes buildup and keeps my skin looking balanced and radiant.

extraits.titre: My skin feels polished, not scratched
extraits.texte: : I love that this uses fruit enzymes instead of rough particles. It buffs away dull skin without feeling abrasive. My face and body both feel incredibly smooth afterward.

reserve: Reviewers do not state their skin type in these excerpts, so segmentation by skin type cannot be produced; findings are organized by concern only.
